label: AI Max Images Per Fact Per Gender
description: Maximum AI images stored per gender per fact (3 genders × this value ≈ total per-fact cap). Oldest images are evicted when reached.

label: Arachnid Fail-Open
description: If false, upload is rejected when the Arachnid scan errors. Recommended: false.

label: Arachnid Shield Enabled
description: When true, every face-source upload is scanned via Project Arachnid Shield before storage.

label: NCMEC Submit — Max Attempts
description: Retry budget for the ncmec_submit queue. With the seeded fourth delay this gives a ~98.6 hour horizon, which is what lets a multi-day CyberTipline outage resolve itself instead of producing a terminal backlog. Lowering it silently shortens that horizon.

label: NCMEC Submit — 4th Retry Delay (ms)
description: Delay before the fourth and subsequent retries of an ncmec_submit job (24h). The queue default of 8h would cut the retry horizon to ~10.5 hours while every surface still reported success.

label: Background Picker: Upload Limit
description: Maximum number of uploaded images shown in the background image picker when creating a meme. Does not affect storage limits.

label: Legendary Tier Generation Budget (USD)
description: Maximum fal.ai generation spend per budget period for users on the Legendary Tier (USD). Applies globally unless a per-user override is set.

label: Registered Tier Generation Budget (USD)
description: Maximum fal.ai generation spend per budget period for users on the Registered Tier (USD).

label: Budget Reset Period
description: How often the per-user generation budget resets. Values: "monthly" (1st of month) or "rolling_30d" (last 30 days).

label: Transactional Email From Address
description: The "From" address used on all outgoing transactional emails (verification, password reset, notifications). Must be a domain verified with Resend.

label: Email Delivery Max Attempts
description: Maximum number of delivery attempts before an outbox email is permanently abandoned. Includes the first attempt. Range: 1–20.

label: Email Outbox Retention (days)
description: Number of days to keep delivered and abandoned emails in the outbox before they are automatically purged. Set to 0 to disable auto-purge.

label: Transactional Email Reply-To Address
description: The "Reply-To" address on all outgoing transactional emails. Users who reply to an automated email will reach this address. Leave blank to use the From address.

label: Email Retry Delay — Attempt 2 (ms)
description: Milliseconds to wait before the 2nd delivery attempt after the 1st failure. Default: 300000 (5 minutes).

label: Email Retry Delay — Attempt 3 (ms)
description: Milliseconds to wait before the 3rd delivery attempt. Default: 1800000 (30 minutes).

label: Email Retry Delay — Attempt 4 (ms)
description: Milliseconds to wait before the 4th delivery attempt. Default: 7200000 (2 hours).

label: Email Retry Delay — Attempt 5 (ms)
description: Milliseconds to wait before the 5th delivery attempt. Default: 28800000 (8 hours).

label: Engine Revision
description: Manual marker bumped on a major engine/LLM change. Facts whose enrichment was processed under an older revision read as stale for reprocess in Taxonomy Health.

label: fal.ai Active Endpoint IDs
description: JSON array of fal.ai endpoint IDs to cache pricing for at startup and refresh hourly.

label: fal.ai Safety Tolerance (PuLID/IP-Adapter)
description: Strictest = "1". Applied to PuLID and IP-Adapter image generation when the model accepts it.

label: Membership grace sweep alert after (s)
description: How long the grace sweep may keep failing before an alert fires. The sweep dying does not revoke anyone late; what degrades is the accuracy of the stored tier, which this surfaces.

label: Membership grace sweep interval (s)
description: How often the convergence sweep recomputes users whose grace window has expired. Lateness here is cosmetic — the read path already enforces the deadline — so this is cheaper than reconciliation and runs more often.

label: Worker instance heartbeat TTL (minutes)
description: How long a worker instance may go without writing a lane heartbeat before it is treated as departed and pruned. Too low and a briefly-paused instance is forgotten; too high and an autoscale scale-down looks like a stalled lane.

label: Entitlement source lease TTL (s)
description: How long one retrieval-and-apply may hold a per-source lease. Must exceed the whole bounded budget: the Stripe retrieval PHASE (every request a prepare makes under one lease — the subscription, its paginated items, a product per item, and for a past_due refresh the invoice/payment/charge lists behind the grace anchor) plus the apply transaction (lock timeout x attempts + backoff), times a 1.5 margin for scheduling jitter. Too short and a valid holder expires mid-work and its fenced write aborts; too long and a crashed holder wedges that source until expiry.

label: Entitlement lease waiter timeout (s)
description: How long a writer waits for a busy source lease before giving up. A waiter that times out abandons its write rather than proceeding unordered; Stripe redelivers the event, so the write is retried rather than lost. This trades latency for nothing and may be short.

label: Max Memes Per Fact
description: Maximum number of memes returned per fact in the gallery (applies to both public and personal views).

label: Name Denylist Patterns (JSON)
description: JSON array of regex patterns rejected on name fields. Keep short — false positives are user-facing.

label: Name Validation: Max Chars Per Word
description: Hard cap on each word inside displayName/firstName/lastName.

label: Name Validation: Max Words
description: Hard cap on the number of whitespace-separated words in displayName/firstName/lastName.

label: NCMEC Backlog Audit Completed At
description: ISO timestamp marking the operator's declaration that the backlog audit is finished. Deliberately separate from the cutoff: the cutoff bounds the work, this records that it was done.

label: NCMEC Backlog Audit Cutoff
description: ISO timestamp bounding the pre-activation backlog audit's SCOPE, captured before review begins. Reports created at or after it are new-code rows and need no audit. Write-once: moving it would shift the scope of an in-progress audit under the operator.

label: NCMEC ISPWS Environment
description: Which CyberTipline host receives submissions: "test" (exttest.cybertip.org, nothing is filed for real) or "production" (report.cybertip.org). Writable only through the guarded /admin/safety config endpoint.

label: NCMEC Report Classifier Hits
description: Whether classifier-sourced quarantines are filed to NCMEC. Hard-blocked in code until NCMEC answers which incident type applies to a classifier hit — this key alone does not enable it.

label: NCMEC Safety Alert Email
description: Fallback recipient for submission-failure alerts when no admin has notifications enabled. Not a reserved key — but production activation is refused unless a recipient resolves, and this key cannot be emptied while production is live.

label: NCMEC Submission Enabled
description: Master switch for automated CyberTipline filing. False means the submission job no-ops and reports stay pending — today's behavior. Writable only through the guarded /admin/safety config endpoint, which refuses activation while the backlog audit is incomplete.

label: NSFW Classifier Fail-Open
description: If true, NSFW classifier timeouts/errors allow uploads through instead of returning 503. Set false to fail closed (default).

label: NSFW Classifier Threshold
description: Probability score at or above which an image is treated as NSFW. Stored as text so we can use floats.

label: NSFW Classifier Timeout (ms)
description: Max time to wait for the NSFW classifier before failing closed.

label: Pricing Cache Refresh Interval (ms)
description: How often to re-fetch fal.ai pricing from the API (milliseconds). Default: 3600000 (1 hour).

label: Quarantine Evidence Retention (days)
description: Minimum days quarantined evidence must be preserved before deletion is permitted.

label: Rate Limit Counter Purge — Batch Size
description: Rows deleted per batch when purging expired rate_limit_counters rows. Bounded (see the job) so a bad value cannot recreate an unbounded DELETE.

label: Rate Limit Counter Purge — Max Batches Per Run
description: Batches per scheduled run before the purger stops and reschedules, so one run cannot hold locks across the whole backlog.

label: Duplicate Flag Threshold (%)
description: Minimum similarity percentage at which a submission is flagged as a duplicate in the moderation panel. Submissions below this threshold will not show duplicate information. Default: 80.

label: Stripe Live Mode
description: When enabled, Stripe uses live credentials and charges real cards. Disable to use test mode.

label: Upload Cap — Legendary (per day)
description: Daily face-source upload cap for Legendary tier users.

label: Upload Cap — Registered (per day)
description: Daily face-source upload cap for free/registered users.

label: User Max Image Storage
description: Total image storage limit per paid user, combining AI-generated images and uploaded photos. Oldest AI images are evicted when limit is reached.
